designDecisions.decision: Constructed a rectangular pool with explicit basin floor, perimeter walls, coping and a dry circulation deck, oriented toward the garden reserve.
designDecisions.limitation: Hydraulics, filtration, waterproofing and any infinity-edge effect are not modelled.

designDecisions.decision: Placed the covered dining terrace directly at the central living/garden threshold rather than using it as a circulation obstruction.
designDecisions.limitation: Dining furniture and kitchen fit-out are deferred.

designDecisions.decision: A separate reading pavilion was not selected so the garden remains open and the dining canopy stays the sole outdoor shelter.
designDecisions.limitation: No separate reading nook is constructed.

designDecisions.decision: A planted private garden is reserved beyond the pool but layered tropical planting cannot be represented with the available direct-scene primitives.
designDecisions.limitation: No editable planting, trees, irrigation or lighting are available in this output.

designDecisions.decision: Balanced the dominant central living volume with unequal bedroom wings while holding a shared roof datum and terrace edge.
designDecisions.limitation: Visual balance is an authored composition, not solver-verified.

designDecisions.decision: Built an actual front-door opening, threshold approach and post-supported entrance canopy.
designDecisions.limitation: Weather performance and code clearances are not certified.

designDecisions.decision: Concentrated the large garden opening at shared living while separating smaller private wing windows with solid wall fields.
designDecisions.limitation: Thermal, acoustic and operability performance are not simulated.

limitations: Surface areas are per physical element; overlapping surfaces are not additional usable area. Enclosed area, requested-space completeness, pool construction and circulation require architectural review. A renderable model is not a completed building.
